notes: HTTP load test: ab -n 500 -c 10 against /bicycles and /bicycles/1, RAILS_ENV=production with precompiled assets (Webpacker JS + Sprockets CSS), DATABASE_URL override pointing at a local dedicated test_app_v6_production database (see prep notes -- database.yml's own production role/password were never provisioned locally). 0 failed requests on both endpoints.
boot_time_seconds/boot_rss_mb measured via `/usr/bin/time -l bin/rails runner "exit"` in RAILS_ENV=production, 5 samples.
test_suite duration is bundle exec rspec's own reported 'Finished in' wall time (test env, not production), 3 samples.

microbench_ips computed as iterations / Benchmark.realtime for fixed iteration counts (ar_validation: 50k Bicycle#valid? calls under RAILS_ENV=production via bin/rails runner; json_roundtrip: 500k JSON.generate+JSON.parse roundtrips of a representative Bicycle-shaped hash; array_sort: 1k iterations of building+sorting a fresh 10k-element random Integer array) -- plain `ruby`, Ruby 3.3.12, no benchmark-ips gem dependency (not in this app's Gemfile). Scripts are ad hoc, not committed to the repo.
puma_rss_after_load_mb is RSS (ps aux, RSS column) of the single Puma worker process immediately after both ab runs completed.
